1.w: Then Bildad the Shuhite spoke up and said:

2.w: “How long will you speak these things, seeing that the words of your mouth are like a great wind?

3.w: Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert what is right?

4.w: If your children sinned against him, he gave them over to the penalty of their sin.

5.w: But if you will look to God and make your supplication to the Almighty,

6.w: if you become pure and upright, even now he will rouse himself for you and will restore your righteous home.

7.w: Your beginning will seem so small, since your future will flourish.

8.w: “For inquire now of the former generation, and pay attention to the findings of their ancestors;

9.w: For we were born yesterday and do not have knowledge, since our days on earth are but a shadow.

10.w: Will they not instruct you and speak to you, and bring forth words from their understanding?

11.w: Can the papyrus plant grow tall where there is no marsh? Can reeds flourish without water?

12.w: While they are still beginning to flower and not ripe for cutting, they can wither away faster than any grass.

13.w: Such is the destiny of all who forget God; the hope of the godless perishes,

14.w: whose trust is in something futile, whose security is a spider’s web.

15.w: He leans against his house, but it does not hold up; he takes hold of it, but it does not stand.

16.w: He is a well-watered plant in the sun; its shoots spread over its garden.

17.w: It wraps its roots around a heap of stones, and it looks for a place among stones.

18.w: If he is uprooted from his place, then that place will disown him, saying, ‘I have never seen you!’

19.w: Indeed, this is the joy of his way, and out of the earth others spring up.

20.w: “Surely, God does not reject a blameless man, nor does he grasp the hand of the evildoers.

21.w: He will yet fill your mouth with laughter and your lips with gladness.

22.w: Those who hate you will be clothed with shame, and the tent of the wicked will be no more.”
